title: Cortical versus cancellous allograft in socket preservation
studyType: Clinical, n=20 vs n=20, all grafts from a single donor, biopsies at ~4.5 months
supports: IMPORTANT NEGATIVE RESULT, and the deck states it honestly: no significant difference in ridge width or height change or in new bone percentage; significantly more residual graft in the cortical group. The deck take-home is that no evidence favours one material for socket preservation. Use this to avoid overclaiming between our own granule options. Cited in botiss training decks (Sept 2026 upload).
